# human rater validation of chatgpt ratings

```{r}
#############################################
# Interrater Reliability (ICC) Analysis Script
# For Temple/Machine Ratings from Qualtrics
#############################################

# --- Load packages ---
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(lme4)
library(performance)

# --- Load dataset ---
data <- read_excel("Chapter 1 - Ratings Validation Qualtrics Export.xlsx")

# ---------- Combine randomized temple columns ----------
# Your columns: "i_1temple", "i_2temple", "i_machine" for i=1..30
for (i in 1:31) {
  col1 <- paste0(i, "_1temple")
  col2 <- paste0(i, "_2temple")
  if (all(c(col1, col2) %in% names(data))) {
    data[[paste0(i, "_temple")]] <- dplyr::coalesce(data[[col1]], data[[col2]])
  }
}
# Drop old randomized temple columns
data <- data %>% select(-matches("_[12]temple$"))

# ---------- Long format ----------
rating_cols <- grep("_(temple|machine)$", names(data), value = TRUE)

long_data <- data %>%
  mutate(participant_id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(rating_cols),
    names_to = c("stimulus", "dimension"),
    names_pattern = "^(\\d+)_(temple|machine)$",
    values_to = "rating",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stimulus = as.integer(stimulus),
    rating = as.numeric(rating)
  )



# ---------- Mean ratings per stimulus × dimension ----------
avg_ratings <- long_data %>%
  group_by(stimulus, dimension) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rating = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rating = sd(rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_raters = n_distinct(participant_id[!is.na(rating)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(avg_ratings)

write_csv(avg_ratings,"avg_ratings.csv")

```

## calculate krippendorf's alpha for raters
using krippendorf's
=.219

```{r}
# overall icc
library(irr)
library(tidyverse)

# Correct orientation: rows = stimuli×dimension (subjects), columns = participants (raters)
rating_matrix <- long_data %>%
  unite("stimulus_dim", stimulus, dimension, remove = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = stimulus_dim,
    names_from = participant_id,
    values_from = rating
  )

# Make sure rows = subjects, columns = raters
rating_mat <- as.matrix(select(rating_matrix, -stimulus_dim))

# Transpose so columns = raters (what kripp.alpha expects)
alpha_overall <- irr::kripp.alpha(t(rating_mat), method = "ordinal")

alpha_overall
```
overall corr = .71

cor.test(corr$mean_rating,corr$`ChatGPT rating`)
